purpose: Section 12: a bounded, deterministic stratified sample (~40-60 cases per the frozen instruction) from existing known datasets only, frozen before adjudication.
sourceManifest: Reuses the same zero-cost deterministic manifest built for Phase 3F.1.5.3 (all 1,115 ground-truth units across fwrg/lsb/conmed/dsgr, unchanged since - the frozen matcher was not modified by this phase's atomic-contract derivation layer). Selection script preserved at docs/evaluation-contract-v3/_sample-build-script.py.

methodology.step2: For each required category (clear credit, clear no-credit, specifically-surfaced failure, silent failure, partial representation, conditions, exceptions, definitions, chapeaus, sibling provisions, quantitative, qualitative, cross-reference-heavy, amendment-sensitive, composite), fill up to 4 NOT-yet-selected cases, preferring higher materiality, deterministic tie-break by case ID.
methodology.step3: Top up FWRG/LSB/CONMED to at least 9 cases each for dataset diversity (DSGR already well-represented via the false-credit controls and category fills).

sampleComposition.silentFailureScarcityDisclosure: Only 2 cases exist system-wide across all 1,115 ground-truth units that are UNREPRESENTED, carry no safety-flag candidate anywhere, and are flagged dangerousUnaccountedV2=true (the strictest 'truly silent, truly dangerous' definition) - both are included. This mirrors the identical scarcity finding from Phase 3F.1.5.3's taxonomy study (its 'unsupported/silent' stratum also had exactly 1-2 such cases) - most real UNREPRESENTED units carry SOME nearby inventory or flag candidate, even when that candidate does not specifically correspond to the claim.
